name: open-creator-graph
description: Look up digital Creators on the Open Creator Graph: accounts, follower counts, topics, location, representation and AI-use terms, each with a source.

interface.longDescription:
The Open Creator Graph is a public registry of digital Creators, run by Sparkonomy. This plugin lets ChatGPT look up any Creator on it and answer with sourced facts instead of guesses.

What's in a Creator's record
- Their accounts across Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X, LinkedIn and more, and which ones belong to the same person.
- Follower and subscriber counts for each platform, shown as ranges, with the date observed.
- What they make: content topics and categories.
- Where they're based, the languages they create in and how long they've been active.
- Representation or management, website, credentials and notable work, where published.
- The terms they've set for AI use of their name, image, likeness, voice, movement and signature: allowed, licence required or not allowed.
- Whether the record is confirmed by the Creator or built from public profiles.

Every value keeps its label, Verified (confirmed by the account owner), Sourced (seen on a public profile) or Stated (the Creator's own words), plus its source and date, so answers can cite it with a link anyone can check.

Good for
- Brands and agencies checking who's behind a handle, how big their audience is and what they make before a campaign.
- Comparing Creators for a shortlist, one lookup at a time.
- Checking what a Creator has agreed to before generating, depicting or training on them.

What to know
- Read-only, with no sign-in or key. Nothing about you is stored.
- Look-ups are by name, handle, SPRK ID or profile URL, not by topic.
- Audience figures are ranges, not exact counts.
- No AI terms means the Creator hasn't set any. Treat that as not allowed, never as permission.
- Coverage is strongest for Creators in India and growing worldwide. Unclaimed records come from public profiles and can be wrong; Creators can claim and correct theirs at creatorgraph.sparkonomy.com.
capabilities: Find a Creator by name, handle, SPRK ID or profile URL
Read a Creator's accounts and follower counts on each platform
Read content topics, location, languages and representation
Read the terms a Creator set for AI use of their identity
defaultPrompt: Who is the Creator kl_bro_biju_rithvik and how big is their audience on each platform?
Summarise Sana Grover's platforms, follower counts and who represents her
Can my brand use an AI version of Sana Grover's voice in an ad?

positive.description: Profile an unclaimed Creator by handle: platforms, audience and topics.
positive.prompt: Who is the Creator behind kl_bro_biju_rithvik? Which platforms are they on, how big is their audience on each, and what do they post about?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds SPRK-00015284 (BIJU.P). Lists Instagram, YouTube and Facebook with each audience range and date, the content topic, and says the record is unclaimed so figures are approximate. Links the record URL.

positive.description: Look up a claimed Creator by SPRK ID for campaign vetting.
positive.prompt: Look up SPRK-00000006 on the Open Creator Graph and summarise her platforms, follower counts, location, languages and who represents her.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Sana Grover's owner-claimed record: platforms with audience ranges, Delhi location, English and Hindi, representation IPLIX Media (Stated). Keeps the Verified/Sourced/Stated labels and links the record.

positive.description: Find a Creator from a profile URL.
positive.prompt: What does the Open Creator Graph have on https://www.instagram.com/kl_bro_biju_rithvik/ ?
positive.expected_behavior: Matches the URL to SPRK-00015284 and summarises the record (name, platforms, audience ranges, topic), with the record link.

positive.description: Check a claimed Creator's AI-use terms before an AI voice ad.
positive.prompt: Can my brand use an AI-generated version of Sana Grover's voice in an Instagram ad? What has she agreed to?
positive.expected_behavior: Says voice needs a licence first; name is allowed; image, likeness and movement need a licence; signature is not allowed. Gives her published licensing contact and links the record and declaration.

positive.description: Check an unclaimed Creator's AI-use terms.
positive.prompt: Can we put an AI-generated version of kl_bro_biju_rithvik's face in an ad?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports no AI consent declaration on SPRK-00015284 (unclaimed) and treats it as not allowed, never as permission: get written consent from the Creator first. Links the record.

negative.description: Unrelated request. The plugin should not be called; ChatGPT answers normally.
negative.prompt: Write a caption for my coffee shop's Instagram post about our new cold brew.

negative.description: Private personal data. The Graph holds no private contact details; ChatGPT should decline and at most point to a contact the Creator published.
negative.prompt: Give me Sana Grover's personal phone number and home address.

negative.description: Ambiguous name with many matches. ChatGPT should ask which Creator (handle or platform) instead of picking one.
negative.prompt: Find Rahul on the Open Creator Graph and tell me his follower count.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0, first release. Read-only lookup of Creators on the Open Creator Graph: search by name, handle, SPRK ID or profile URL; read a Creator's record (accounts and follower counts per platform, topics, location, languages, representation) with Verified, Sourced or Stated labels; read the AI-use terms a Creator has set. No sign-in and no write actions.
